newsitem.title: USA: Transcrypt goes public after trimming IPO.
newsitem.headline: Transcrypt goes public after trimming IPO.

text.p: Shares of Transcrypt International Inc climbed slightly on their first day of trading on Wednesday after the company sharply cut back terms of its initial public offering.
The shares rose 3/4 to 8-3/4 in early trading.
The Lincoln, Nebraska company initially estimated an IPO of 3.75 million shares to price in a range of $12 to $14 with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.

It finally offered 2.9 million shares for $8 each, below a revised pricing range of $10 to $11 a share, according to lead underwriter Dain Bosworth. Of the total number of shares, 2.5 million were offered by the company and 400,000 by selling shareholders.
The company makes products aimed at blocking unauthorized access to voice and data communications.
The gross spread on the deal was $0.56, the underwriter said.
